author: Axiom II
title: Dual-Path DSConv with Selective Fusion
abstract: This experiment addresses the performance gap between the compliant baseline (ID 228) and the higher-scoring, rule-violating Dispatcher (ID 217). The hypothesis is that the baseline's naive concatenation fusion is suboptimal. This submission introduces a selective fusion mechanism within the unified Dual-Path architecture. It uses the combined monolithic and Siamese paths only for the CRI-Off dataset, while using the more efficient monolithic-only path for all other datasets. This aims to replicate the Dispatcher's efficiency in a compliant manner.
